blocks.orig: Ahadi Lodge is a small-scale lodge in an authentic residential area in the heart of Arusha, where you get an impression of everyday life in Tanzania while still enjoying the peaceful surroundings. The relatively small rooms are set in a lush tropical garden, surrounding the swimming pool. Every room has a different colour and theme, and is equipped with double or twin beds, an ensuite bathroom with a shower, a TV and a safe. In addition, there’s a small restaurant serving nice food – the friendly staff makes it a guest favourite. Ahadi is a cashless lodge, so meals and drinks are paid by card.
blocks.html: In the heart of Arusha, in a genuine residential neighbourhood, you find Ahadi Lodge, a small-scale lodge where you see something of daily life in Tanzania while still enjoying calm surroundings. The rooms are fairly small and lie in a lush tropical garden around the swimming pool. Each room has its own colour and theme and comes with double or twin beds, an ensuite bathroom with a shower, a TV and a safe. There is also a small restaurant with good food – and guests love the friendly staff. Ahadi does not accept cash, so you pay for meals and drinks by card.
